intro.h2: A Lake Wales cabinet shop that people come back to
paragraphs: Custom By Alvarez has been building and installing kitchen cabinets in Lake Wales since 1995, with cabinets, solid surface and countertops shown at its shop at 18720 US-27. You can stop by the showroom, look at materials, and talk the job through face to face.

What reviewers mention most is the people. Chris, Mary and Liz help you choose, and they are patient while you decide. One customer wrote that his brother used them 25 years ago and that kitchen still looks beautiful. Another thanked Luis, who handles the electrical and plumbing portion, so the sink and appliances are hooked up by the same team that set the cabinets.

about.h2: The people behind Custom By Alvarez
about.text: Custom By Alvarez is a Lake Wales cabinet and countertop shop with its showroom and work truck based at 18720 US-27. The banner over the shop windows reads cabinets, solid surface, countertops, established 1995. Customers know the team by first name: Chris and Liz walked one couple through their kitchen choices, Mary and Chris built another family their new kitchen, and Luis handles the electrical and plumbing portion of the work. The owners answer their Google reviews themselves and still invite customers back to the showroom after the job is done.

image.alt: Custom By Alvarez storefront at 18720 US-27 in Lake Wales with a cabinets, solid surface and countertops banner

process.h2: How a Custom By Alvarez project works

steps.title: Visit or call
steps.text: Call (863) 439-3889 or stop by the US-27 showroom Tuesday to Saturday to talk about your kitchen or bath.

steps.title: Estimate and recommendations
steps.text: The team gives you an estimate and recommends cabinets and tops for your space, and takes the time you need to decide.

steps.title: Design your kitchen
steps.text: Choose door style, colour and countertop with the team, who help design the kitchen layout with you.

steps.title: Install and hook up
steps.text: The crew installs cabinets and countertops on schedule, and Luis handles the electrical and plumbing portion such as the sink.

steps.title: Enjoy it
steps.text: You walk through the finished kitchen together. Several customers say they would use Custom By Alvarez again and recommend them to family.

service_area.h2: Kitchen cabinets in Lake Wales and nearby
service_area.text: Custom By Alvarez works out of its showroom at 18720 US-27 in Lake Wales, Florida, where you can see cabinets, solid surface and countertops in person. If you live in or around Lake Wales, call (863) 439-3889 to ask whether your address is in range, or drop in Tuesday through Saturday between 9 AM and 5 PM. Every project starts at the same Lake Wales showroom, so you always know where to find the team.

items.q: Where is the Custom By Alvarez showroom?
items.a: The shop is at 18720 US-27, Lake Wales, FL 33853. Look for the storefront with the large cabinets, solid surface and countertops banner. The owners encourage customers to stop by the showroom, so you can see cabinet doors and countertop materials in person before you choose.

The showroom is open Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday from 9 AM to 5 PM. It is closed on Sunday and Monday. Outside those hours you can call (863) 439-3889 or email cbatops@aol.com and the team will get back to you to set up a time.

items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: Cabinets, solid surface and countertops are the core of the business, as the shop banner says. Google reviewers also mention full new kitchens, countertop replacement, bathroom cabinets and sink installation, with the electrical and plumbing portion handled by Luis on the team.

items.q: How long have you been in business?
items.a: The Custom By Alvarez banner on the shop reads established 1995. One Google reviewer chose them after comparing years in business, and wrote that his brother used them 25 years ago and that kitchen still looks beautiful since the day it was installed.

items.q: How do I get an estimate?
items.a: Call (863) 439-3889, email cbatops@aol.com or visit the showroom on US-27 during opening hours to talk about your kitchen or bath project. Reviewers describe comparing several estimate quotes and choosing Custom By Alvarez after talking with Chris and Liz about their recommendations.
